result.summary: The page has a couple of content-related issues, including a typo and a nonsensical discount badge.

issues.description: The address section header contains a typo: 'DELEVER TO' instead of 'DELIVER TO'.
A discount badge showing '-0%' is visible on the pizza image in the 'Popular right now' section.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge if the discount value is 0, or fix the calculation logic so it only displays valid discounts.
